definitions: A building devoted to the worship, or regarded as the dwelling place, of a god or gods or other objects of religious reverence.
The flattened region on either side of the head between the forehead and the ear.
A place of worship for Jews or some other religions.
examples: The ancient temple was dedicated to Zeus.
He felt a throbbing pain in his temple.
They attended services at the local temple.
The Masons meet in their temple.
